entry.name: mc.live.gain~
entry.category: Live UI Objects, Live MSP Objects
entry.description: mc.live.gain~ is a slider that scales input audio signals and provides a visual indication of the current sound level on a deciBel scale.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Toggles the object's active mode. When theattribute is set to 0, mouse action does not cause output and the inactive colors are used.

messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out theobject's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, themessage will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.
